translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Wee ye Yinni Gusunɔ u geruɑ Bɑbilonin sɔ̃. U nɛɛ,

content.text: kon de woo gu Bɑbiloni swee,
ye kɑ yen tɔmbu,
kpɑ gu bu kɑm koosiɑ.
Kon de tɔmbu bu bu yɑrinɑsiɑ
nge mɛ woo gɑ rɑ yɑkɑsu yɑrinɑsie.
Tɔ̃ɔ kɔ̃su te sɔɔ, bɑ koo ye wɔrimɑ bɑɑmɑn di.
Tɛn towobu bu wuu gen tɔmbu tweeyo.
Bu yɛ̃ro tweeyo wi u win tɑrɑkpe nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ.
Bu ku gen ɑluwɑɑsibɑ deri.
Bu gen tɑbu kowobu kpuro goowo.
Kpɑ bu ben gonu deri
nu n kpĩ kpĩ ben tem kpuro sɔɔ kɑ Bɑbilonin swɛɛyɔ.
Domi bɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni Dɛɛro torɑri n kpɑ̃.
Adɑmɑ wi, Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni,
u kɑ win tɔmbu Isirelibɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
I duki yɑrio Bɑbilonin di.
Bɑɑwure u win wɑ̃ɑru wɔro,
kpɑ u ku rɑɑ gbi Bɑbiloni ye sɔɔ,
ye, ye yɑ koo ko bɑnsu mi.
Domi Yinni Gusunɔn mɔrun tɔ̃rɑ tunumɑ.
U koo Bɑbilonigibu ben kookoosun ɑre wɛ̃.
Bɑbiloni yɑ rɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nge nɔrɑ wurɑgiɑ Yinni Gusunɔn nɔmɑ sɔɔ.
Yerɑ u kɑ hɑnduniɑgibu tɑm wɛ̃ bɑ nɔrɑ
sere mu bu go bɑ wiru biɑ.
Wee subɑru sɔɔ, Bɑbiloni yɑ wɔrumɑ yɑ kɔsikirɑ.
I gɔɔ swĩiyɔ yen sɔ̃,
kpɑ i kɑ tim nɑ i doke mi yɑ bosu wɑ.
Sɔrɔkudo yɑ koo bɛkurɑ.
Sɔɔ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi, bɑ nɛɛ,
sɑ Bɑbiloni tim kɑ̃,
ɑdɑmɑ yɑ ǹ bɛkure.
Su ye deri su gɔsirɑ bɛsɛn temɔ,
domi yen sɛɛyɑsiɑ bi, bu kpɑ̃
sere bu nɔɔrɑ hɑnduniɑ kpuro sɔɔ.
Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni u sun siriɑ.
Su dɑ Siɔniɔ su kpɑrɑ ye u sun kuɑ.

content: Yinni Gusunɔ u kĩ u Bɑbiloni kɑm koosiɑ, kpɑ u win sɑ̃ɑ yee dɛɛrɑru mɔru kɔsiɑ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ u Mɛdibɑn sinɑmbu dɑm kɛ̃mɔ bu kɑ ye wɔri.

content.text: I bɛɛn sɛ̃ɛnun nɔsu sɔnwɔ,
kpɑ i bɛɛn tɛrɛnu suɑ.
I yĩreru koowo kpɑ i Bɑbiloni wɔri.
Wuun kɔ̃sobu, bu wureo bu yɔ̃rɔ sɔmɛ ben kɔ̃su yerɔ.
I Bɑbiloni yɔɔru bwɛ̃ɛyɔ.
Domi ye Yinni Gusunɔ u yɔ̃rɑri u ko ye sɔɔ,
u koo ye kowɑ.
Wunɛ Bɑbiloni, wunɛ wi ɑ sɔ̃ dɑɑ bɑkɑnun bɔkuɔ,
wunɛ wi ɑ dukiɑ yibɑ,
wee wunɛn kpeerun tɔ̃ru tɑ turɑ.
Wunɛn binɛ yɑ koo kpe.
Domi Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni,
u bɔ̃ruɑ u nɛɛ, sere kɑ win wɑ̃ɑru,
u koo nun tɔmbu kpɑremɑ nge twee
kpɑ bu nun nɑsɑrɑn kuuki koosi.

content: Yinni Gusunɔn yiiko

content.text: Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u tem tɑkɑ kuɑ kɑ win dɑm.
Wiyɑ u mɑɑ hɑnduniɑ swĩi kɑ win yɛ̃ru,
mɑ u wɔllu tɛriɑ kɑ win bwisi.
Ù n nɔɔgiru suɑ u woodɑ wɛ̃,
nim mu rɑ kpɑɑsinɛwɑ wɔllɔ,
kpɑ guru winu nu n sĩimɔ,
kpɑ guru mɑɑkinu nu de gurɑ yu nɛ,
kpɑ woo gu seemɑ gen wɑ̃ɑ yerun di.
Tɔmbu bɑ̀ n ye kpuro mɛɛrɑ,
bɑ rɑ biti soorewɑ,
kpɑ sekuru tu bwɑ̃ɑrokunun sekobu mwɑ,
domi nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ weesu, nu ǹ wɑ̃ɑru mɔ.
Nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ kɑm dirum mɛ mu tɔmbu nɔni wɔ̃kumɔ.
Ni kpuro nu koo doonɑwɑ
sɑnɑm mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u koo nu sɛɛyɑsiɑ.
Adɑmɑ Gusunɔ u ǹ sɑ̃ɑ nge bwɑ̃ɑroku ni.
U sɑ̃ɑwɑ Isirelibɑn ɑrumɑni.
Wiyɑ u kpuro tɑkɑ kuɑ,
wiyɑ u mɑɑ Isirelibɑ mɔ.
Win yĩsirɑ Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni.

content: Bɑbilonin kpeeru
Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ,

content.text: Bɑbiloni, ɑ rɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nge nɛn mɑtɑlɑkɑ bɑkɑ tɑbu sɔɔ.
Wunɑ nɑ dendɑ nɑ kɑ bwese dɑbinu kɔsukɑ,
mɑ nɑ nin bɑnnu sururɑ.
Wunɑ nɑ mɑɑ dendɑ nɑ kɑ mɑɑsɔbu
kɑ ben dumi kɔsukɑ,
kɑ tɑbu kɛkɛ yi dumi gɑwe kɑ yin kpɑrobu,
kɑ durɔbu kɑ kurɔbu,
tɔkɔnu kɑ bibu, ɑluwɑɑsibɑ kɑ wɔndiɑbɑ.
Wunɑ nɑ mɑɑ dendɑ nɑ kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kpɑrobu kɑ ben yɑ̃ɑnu kɔsukɑ
kɑ gbɑɑ wukobu kɑ ben nɑɑ wukubɑ
kɑ sinɑmbu kɑ ben sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbu.
Adɑmɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ,
kon wunɛ Bɑbiloni kɑ wunɛn tem tɔmbu kɔsie
wunɛn nɔni biru kɔ̃sɑ ye i kuɑ Siɔniɔ.
Kon nun wɔrimɑ, wunɛ wi ɑ sɑ̃ɑ
nge guu te tɑ hɑnduniɑgibu kpuro kɑm koosiɑ.
Kon nun nɔmɑ dɛmiɛ,
kpɑ ɑ bindɑ ɑ wɔrumɑ temɔ.
Kɑɑ kowɑ nge guu te tɑ dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑ.
Bɑɑ wunɛn kperu gɑru,
bɑ ǹ mɑɑ suɑmɔ bu kɑ dirun koru swĩi.
Kɑɑ kowɑ bɑnsu sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni geruɑ.
I tɑbun gidi bɔrɑ yɔ̃rɑsio i Bɑbiloni wɔri.
I kɔbɑ soowo kpɑ bwesenu nu mɛnnɑ.
I nu sɔɔru koosio.
I sinɑm be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Arɑrɑtiɔ kɑ Miniɔ
kɑ Asikenɑsiɔ mɛnnɑmɑ bu Bɑbiloni tɑbu wɔri.
I tɑbu sinɑmbu gɔsio
kpɑ i de dumi yi se nge twee
yi bu wɔri.
I bwesenu kpuro sɔɔru koosio
n mɑm nɛɛre Mɛdibɑn sinɑmbu
kɑ ben berɑ kɑ berɑn wirugibu
kɑ sere tɔn be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ ben tem sɔɔ kpuro.
Wee tem mu yĩirimɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔn himbɑ yɑ koo koorɑ Bɑbiloni sɔɔ.
U koo de yu ko bɑnsu.
Yen tɑbu durɔbu bɑ koo kpɑnɑ bu mɑɑ tɑbu ko.
Bɑ koo dɑ bu kuke kuku yee dɑmginu sɔɔ.
Ben dɑm mu koo kpe,
kpɑ bu ko nge tɔn kurɔbu.
Ben gbɑ̃rɑ kɔnnɔsu ko n wukiɑre,
kpɑ bu ben yɛnusu dɔ̃ɔ doke.
Sɔmɔbu bɑ ko n dɑɑmɔ bɑ n wurɑmɑmɔ
bu kɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko sɔ̃
mɑ bɑ win wuu mwɑ beri berikɑ.
Bɑ swɛɛ kpuro bɔɔrɑ.
Bɑ mɑɑ kuku yenu kpuro dɔ̃ɔ mɛni.
Mɑ tɑbu durɔbu bɑ wurure.

content: Amɛniwɑ Gusunɔ, Isirelibɑn Yinni wi u wɔllu kɑ tem mɔ u geruɑ. U nɛɛ,

content.text: wee yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ koo nɑ bu Bɑbilonigibu suriri
kpɑ bu bu tɑɑku nge dobi
yi yi wɑ̃ɑ doo soo yerɔ.

content: Yinni Gusunɔ
u koo Isirelibɑ somi
Yerusɑlɛmu yɑ nɛɛ,

content.text: Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ u rɑɑ mɑn gurɑ,
mɑ u mɑn deri nge weke diiru.
U mɑn sɛ̃re nge yɑɑ gɔbɑ,
mɑ u suɑ ye yɑ geɑ sɑ̃ɑ kpuro nɛ sɔɔ.
Yen biru u nɛn tɔmbu girɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, Bɑbilonigii be, bu nɔni sɔ̃ɔro dɑm mɛ bɑ mɑn dɔren sɔ̃,
kpɑ yɛm mɛ bɑ yɑri mi, mu wɔri ben wiru wɔllɔ.

content: Wee ye Yinni Gusunɔ u geruɑ Yerusɑlɛmugibun sɔ̃. U nɛɛ,

content.text: wee, kon bɛɛ sɑnnɑ.
Kon Bɑbilonin dɑɑnu kɑ yen bwii kpuro gberɑsiɑ.
Bɑbiloni koo kowɑ bɑnsu
mi gbeeku bɔ̃nu nu ko n wɑ̃ɑ.
Tɔnu kun ko n mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi,
kpɑ bu ye yɛ̃ɛ.
Wee yen tɔmbɑ ginɑ sɑ̃ɑ nge gbee sinɑnsu si su kukirimɔ.
Adɑmɑ sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ gɑ̀rì seewɑ,
kon de bu tɑm nɔ sere n bɑndɑ,
kpɑ bɑ n nuku dobu mɔ̀,
kpɑ mu bu go, bu dweeyɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ seemɔ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni geruɑ.
Kon bu sɑkiriwɑ nge yɑ̃ɑnu kɑ bonu yɑɑ goo yerɔ.

content: Bɑ Bɑbiloni gɔɔ swĩiyɑmmɛ
Wee ye Yinni Gusunɔ u geruɑ Bɑbilonin sɔ̃. U nɛɛ,

content.text: ɑnnɑ ɑ wɑ mɑ Bɑbiloni,
wuu bɔkɔ ge tɔmbɑ rɑɑ siɑrɑmɔ,
yɑ wɔrumɑ.
Wee, yɑ kuɑ bɑnsu bwesenu kpuron suunu sɔɔ.
Nim kurenu nu ye swee,
mɑ nu ye wukiri.
Yen bɑru kpɑɑnu nu kuɑ bɑnsu,
mɑ tem mu gberɑ mu kuɑ tem sɑɑrɑm.
Goo kun mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi.
Goo ku rɑ mɑɑ sɑre mi.
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nɛɛ,
kon Bɑbilonin bũu wi bɑ mɔ̀ Bɛli seesi.
Kon nùn siɑsiɑ ye u rɑɑ mwɛ,
kpɑ tɔmbu bu ku mɑɑ nɑ win mi.
Wee Bɑbilonin gbɑ̃rɑrɑ wɔrumɑ.
Bɛɛ, nɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑ, i yɑrio min di.
Bɑɑwure u win wɑ̃ɑru wɔro nɛn mɔru bɑkɑ ye yɑ ween di.

content: I ku nɑndɑ. I ku mɑɑ diiri lɑbɑɑri ye yɑ nɔɔrɑmɔ tem mɛ kpuro sɔɔn sɔ̃. Wɔ̃ɔ bɑɑgere kɑ gen lɑbɑɑriwɑ. Tɔmbu bɑ ko n dɑm diinɑmɔ, kpɑ sinɑmbu bɑ n seesinɑmɔ.

content.text: Adɑmɑ sɔ̃ɔ teeru kon Bɑbilonin bũnu seesi,
kpɑ yen tem kpuron tɔmbu bu sekuru wɑ.
Gonu nu ko n tɛriewɑ bɑɑmɑ kpuro.
Wɔllɔ kɑ temɔ kɑ yɑm kpuro,
nuku dobun kuuki koo nɔɔrɑ Bɑbilonin sɔ̃.
Domi yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ koo nɑ sɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm geu giɑn di,
bu ye kpeerɑsiɑ.
Yen tɔmbɑ tɔn dɑbinu go hɑnduniɑ kpuro sɔɔ.
Tɛ̃ yen tiin sɑɑ yɑ tunumɑ yu kɑ wɔrumɑ.
Domi bɑ Isirelibɑ dɑbinu go.
Bɛɛ Isirelibɑ, bɛɛ be i kisirɑ ben nɔmɑn di,
i ku mɑɑ yɔ̃rɑ mini.
I doonɔ n tomɑ Bɑbilonin di.
Sɑɑ min di, i Yinni Gusunɔ yɑɑyo
kɑ bɛɛn wuu Yerusɑlɛmu.

content: Mɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ nɛɛ,

content.text: sɑnɑm mɛ sɑ nuɑ bɑ sun wɔmmɔ,
sekurɑ rɑ sun mwɛwɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yeru wɔri bɑ kɔsukɑ,
sekurɑ sun mwɑwɑ.

content: Adɑmɑ wi, Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ,

content.text: wee, tɔ̃nu sisi nì sɔɔ u koo Bɑbilonin bũnu seesi,
kpɑ be bɑ mɛɛrɑ wɑn wuri yi nɔɔrɑ tem kpuro sɔɔ.
Bɑɑ Bɑbilonigibu bɑ̀ n seewɑ bɑ dɑ wɔllɔ,
bɑɑ bɑ̀ n ben gbɑ̃rɑnun dɑm sosi
sere goo kun kpɛ̃ u dɑ mi,
kɑ mɛ, u koo de yibɛrɛbɑ bu bu wɔri bu kɑm koosiɑ.
Kɑm kobu Bɑbilonin tem deemɑ,
mɑ kuuki nɔɔrɑmɔ yen wusu sɔɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u ben wusu kɑm koosiɑ.
U koo de ben kuuki yi kpe.
Yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ wee bɑ wɔki nge nim wɔ̃ku.
Bɑ wee bu Bɑbilonigii be wɔri,
kpɑ bu ben tɑbu kowo dɑmgibu mwɛɛri bu ben tɛnnu bɔɔku.
Domi Gusunɔ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Yinni
wi u rɑ bɑɑwure kɔsie ye u kuɑ.

content: U sɑ̃ɑwɑ sunɔ. Win yĩsirɑ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni. U nɛɛ, u koo de tɑm mu Bɑbilonin sinɑmbu go, kɑ ben bwisigibu kɑ ben tem yɛ̃robu kɑ ben wirugibu kɑ ben tɑbu durɔ dɑmgibu kpɑ bu dweeyɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ bɑ kun mɑɑ seewe.

content.text: Bɑbilonin gbɑ̃rɑ bɑkɑ ni, nu koo wɔrumɑ.
Nin kɔnnɔ bɑkɑ si, su koo dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑ.
Nge mɛyɑ sɔmbu te bɑ kuɑ gbɑ̃rɑ ten sɔ̃, tɑ koo kɑm ko.
Ben hɑniɑ kpuro yɑ koo kɑm kowɑ dɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ.

content: Bɑ Yeremin tireru kpɛ̃ɛ
dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Efɑrɑtiɔ
Serɑyɑ, Nɛriyɑn bii, Mɑseyɑn debubu, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Sedesiɑsi, Yudɑbɑn sinɑ bokon sɔm kowobun wirugii. Sedesiɑsin bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ nnɛse sɔɔrɑ bɑ dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ wi kɑ sinɑ boko.
Yerɑ Yeremi u yoruɑ tireru sɔɔ kɔ̃sɑ ye yɑ koo Bɑbiloni deemɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ gɑri kpuro yi Yinni Gusunɔ u geruɑ Bɑbilonin sɔ̃.
Mɑ u Serɑyɑ yiire u nɛɛ, sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ turɑ Bɑbiloniɔ, ɑ kookɑri koowo ɑ gɑri yini gɑri kɑ dɑm tɔmbu bu nɔ.
Kpɑ ɑ kɑnɑru ko ɑ nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ, wunɑ ɑ geruɑ ɑ nɛɛ, goo kun mɑɑ sinɑmɔ Bɑbiloniɔ sere kɑ yɛɛyɔ. Yɑ koo kowɑ bɑnsu sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
À n tire te gɑrɑ ɑ kpɑ, ɑ tu kperu gbinisio kpɑ ɑ tu kpɛ̃ɛ dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Efɑrɑtiɔ,
kpɑ ɑ nɛɛ, nge mɛ tire te, tɑ numɑ mi, nge mɛyɑ Bɑbiloni yɑ koo kɑm ko. Yɑ ǹ mɑɑ seemɔ, kɔ̃sɑ ye Yinni Gusunɔ u ye suremɔn sɔ̃. Yɑ koo wɔrumɑwɑ kpɑ yɑ kun mɑɑ dɑm mɔ. Yeremin gɑrin kpurowɑ mi.
Yerusɑlɛmu yɑ wɔrumɑ
